states.label: Planning call only the owner can make
Handed off, in the sentinel inbox
Merge call only the owner can make

transitions.label: opens muse
transitions.event: owner opens /ob-muse for a project

transitions.label: looks whole
transitions.event: thought looks whole; muse asks with the question tool

transitions.label: no, keep going
transitions.event: owner says no or let me think

transitions.label: yes, ticket it
transitions.event: owner says yes; ob add, then t3_thread_send (queue) to the team architect

transitions.label: note a raw idea
transitions.event: owner asks to note a raw idea; ob add + ob tag idea

transitions.label: picks it up
transitions.event: owner returns to the idea

transitions.label: next three in queue
transitions.event: ticket is in the next three of the architect's queue

transitions.label: seal score, run checker
transitions.event: architect seals its score; runs the Haiku checker on ob spinoff brief

transitions.label: go
transitions.event: ob spinoff check: every checker question resolved (go)

transitions.label: no-go, change ticket
transitions.event: ob spinoff check: an unresolved question (no-go); change the ticket, at most twice

transitions.label: owner's call
transitions.event: the open question is the owner's call

transitions.label: answer
transitions.event: owner answers

transitions.label: only by trying
transitions.event: unknown only by trying; spike ticket dispatched (no score, needs Questions, Box, Done when)

transitions.label: answers on parent
transitions.event: spike answers with ob note on the parent; architect rescores

transitions.label: spike closed
transitions.event: ob close on the spike; row ends failed with a spike error

transitions.label: no-check with reason
transitions.event: still under 70 after two tries: dispatch with --no-check '<why>'

transitions.label: ob spinoff
transitions.event: ob spinoff <ref>; refused without Drilled, Done when and go

transitions.label: claim
transitions.event: launch claims the row

transitions.label: thread opened
transitions.event: T3 thread opened; row stamped launched

transitions.label: retry launch
transitions.event: spawn failure or stale claim, under MAX_LAUNCH_ATTEMPTS (2)

transitions.label: attempt cap hit
transitions.event: spawn failure at the attempt cap

transitions.label: abandon
transitions.event: abandoned before launch

transitions.label: abandon or lost trial
transitions.event: abandoned, or lost a trial pair

transitions.label: review legs run
transitions.event: build and local gate done; review legs launched on git diff main...HEAD

transitions.label: open finding, fix
transitions.event: a wrong finding, or a rejected answer, is open; fix and run the next (rebuttal) round

transitions.label: 0 open, open PR
transitions.event: 0 open; rebase, push, gh pr create

transitions.label: CI fails, fix
transitions.event: a CI check fails; fix on the branch

transitions.label: handoff, CI green
transitions.event: verdict landable and CI green: ob spinoff handoff (note to the team sentinel, else architect)

transitions.label: verdict needs-human
transitions.event: verdict needs-human; builder asks with the question tool

transitions.label: owner hands off
transitions.event: owner runs /ob-spinoff-handoff (the human yes)

transitions.label: owner asks a change
transitions.event: owner answers with a change to make

transitions.label: verdict blocked
transitions.event: verdict blocked: a decision or access is missing; no PR

transitions.label: verdict partial
transitions.event: verdict partial: some Done when items unmet; no PR

transitions.label: owner unblocks
transitions.event: owner gives the decision or access

transitions.label: redispatch
transitions.event: architect redispatches or steers the rest

transitions.label: read inbox
transitions.event: the sentinel (else the architect) reads its inbox, oldest first, and starts the gate

transitions.label: sendback
transitions.event: red CI, a Done when item unmet, or a claim it cannot verify: ob spinoff sendback

transitions.label: conflict or overlap
transitions.event: PR conflicts, or is behind main with an overlap

transitions.label: pushed, re-gate
transitions.event: rebased or merged main, pushed, re-gate the new head

transitions.label: taste, waiver or flake
transitions.event: a taste call, a waived check, or a known flake

transitions.label: owner answers
transitions.event: owner answers

transitions.label: merge and deploy
transitions.event: every gate question yes: gh pr merge --squash, then ob deploy run --sha

transitions.label: ob close
transitions.event: ob close: ticket done, rows landed, unread handoffs withdrawn

transitions.label: reopen
transitions.event: ob spinoff reopen: an exception for a row that reconcile landed although nothing merged
